svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of an Art Nouveau metro entrance: a cast-iron balustrade of whiplash curves and leaves between bud-topped posts, two tall lamp stems curving toward a lettered arch sign, and the stairs going down behind, with a round close-up of one lamp stem and its curl. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
